definitions.family_friendly: A place that welcomes families with children: kids menus, play areas, children's programs, activities for all ages, child care.
definitions.business_friendly: A place suited for business customers: meeting rooms, business lunches, corporate events, services for business travelers and colleagues.
definitions.work_friendly: A place where people can work: wifi, laptop-friendly seating, quiet space to work, remote workers and students welcome.
definitions.pet_friendly: A place that welcomes pets and dogs: dogs allowed, pet-friendly patio, pet amenities, animal-friendly policy.
definitions.romantic: A romantic atmosphere for couples and date nights: candlelit dinner, intimate ambiance, romantic setting for two.
definitions.groups_events: A place that hosts groups, parties and events: private event space, group dining, banquet rooms, party hosting, event venues.
definitions.late_night: A place open late at night with nightlife: late-night hours, nightclub, dancing, bar atmosphere after dark.
definitions.accessible: A place accessible to people with disabilities: wheelchair-accessible entrance, ADA compliance, accessible restrooms and facilities.
definitions.casual: A casual, relaxed place for everyday visits: casual dining, informal atmosphere, no dress code, everyday meals with friends.
definitions.upscale: An upscale, elegant, fine-dining experience: fine dining, refined ambiance, luxury setting, upscale cuisine and service.
definitions.cozy: A cozy, intimate, comfortable atmosphere: warm cozy ambiance, small intimate space, comfortable relaxed setting.
definitions.community_focused: A community-oriented place serving local residents: community gatherings, neighborhood events, community atmosphere.
definitions.lively: A lively, vibrant, energetic atmosphere: vibrant ambiance, bustling energy, sports-bar excitement, music-filled social scene.
definitions.seniors: A place serving seniors and elderly adults: senior living, assisted living, memory care, elder care, senior programs.
definitions.beginner_friendly: Classes and activities suitable for beginners: beginner-level instruction, newcomers without experience welcome.
definitions.adults_only: A venue restricted to adults: 21 and over, adults-only atmosphere, no children allowed.
definitions.lgbtq_friendly: A place that is LGBTQ-friendly and affirming: welcoming to LGBTQ customers, inclusive pride-friendly atmosphere.
